data.name: Milan's Artistic Renaissance: Private Tour with tickets
data.description: Explore the artistic wonders of the Italian Renaissance on this immersive private tour of Milan, a city famous for its fashion, art and architecture with visits to some of its pre-eminent museums, churches, palaces and quarters of the city. On your private tour, you will:  Pass by the impressive Sforzesco Castle, a vast 15th-century fortress built by Francesco Sforza, the Duke of Milan: a veritable citadel and repository of incredible art;  Discover the treasure troves of Renaissance Italian Art in the Poldi Pezzoli Museum, including pieces by Botticelli, Bellini and Mantegna; Explore the Bagatti Valsecchi Museum, which showcases a range of art and antiques from the 15th and 16th centuries, including paintings by masters like Giovanni Bellini; Explore Milan’s notorious fashion quarter - the opulent Quadrilatero d’Oro, or Golden Quadrangle, where you can find every major fashion house including Gucci, Armani, and Versace; End your tour with a visit to the Chiesa di San Maurizio al Monastero Maggiore, a 16th-century royal chapel and former Benedictine nunnery, famous for its exquisite frescoes and the ‘Hall of Nuns’.  Milan is a vast, affluent modern city in the north of Italy – a central hub of Italian finance and industry. It is also famous for its fashion, its Renaissance architecture – and of course its art collections. Your tour takes you to some lesser-known gems, ‘museum houses’ to discover the artistic heart of this vibrant city. On your private walking tour, you will discover these artistic treasure troves in the Poldi Pezzoli and Bagatti Valsecchi Museums, and learn about the magnificent Castello Sforzesco, and the beautiful church of San Maurizio. The Poldi Pezzoli has variously been described as a casket of wonders, a shrine of art and precious things, and was the life-passion of Gian Giacomo Poldi Pezzoli, an Italian count and voracious art collector in the 19th century. The museum is his private house, filled with gems from the Italian Renaissance by artists such as Botticelli, Canaletto, Bellini and Piero Della Francesco among others. It contains a vast, eclectic collection of paintings, drawings, sculptures, armoury, jewellery, clocks and watches, porcelain and pottery, glass and textiles. Truly Aladdin’s Cave of Wonders. Next, explore another historic ‘house museum’ the fabulous and eccentric Museo Bagatti Valsecchi with a stunning collection of sculptures and paintings from the Renaissance. Founded by two brothers, Barons Giuseppe and Fausto Bagatti Valsecchi at the end of the 19th century, it is filled with art, pottery, scientific instruments and of course Renaissance masterpieces. Of particular note is Bellini’s Saint Justine. As Giuseppe described it: “The intention was not to create a museum or a collection, but to reconstruct a lordly mansion of the mid-16th century in which were very disparate objects of the 15th and 16th centuries: paintings; tapestries; rugs; furniture; arms; ceramics; items of bronze, glass and iron; jewellery, and domestic utensils of every kind, all collected with careful study and returned to their original use.” Very close by, enjoy a stroll through Milan’s famous fashion district, the Quadrilatero d'Or, the world's most famous upmarket shopping district including Chanel, Versace, Gucci and all the major houses! Lastly, visit the quietly majestic Church of San Maurizio al Monastero Maggiore, a royal chapel built in the 16th Century, often missed by tourists, with stunning frescos and a peaceful atmosphere.

data.name: Explore Milan in a Day: Private Full-Day Tour including Sforzesco Castle
data.description: Explore the many cultural and architectural highlights of Milan, and learn about its long and varied history from a humble village in the 6th century BC to an important Renaissance stronghold, to the modern financial and fashion centre of Italy today.  On your private full-day tour, you will: See the famous Teatro Alla Scala, one of the world's oldest and most famous theatres; Walk along the iconic Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, with its luxury fashion shops and the famous quadrilatero della moda; Pick up invaluable recommendations, advice, and tips on finding the best, local food as you explore highlights and off-the-beaten-track side streets; Stop for photos at the famous Duomo, Milan’s stunning centrepiece; Visit the Chiesa San Satiro, known for its false apse, an architectural optical illusion, attributed to Donato Bramante; Wander through Piazza degli Affari and hear about the meaning of Il Dito sculpture; Learn all about modern life in Milan while taking in the atmosphere and the beauty of this vibrant city; Admire the Chiesa di San Maurizio al Monastero Maggiore with stunning frescos that often go missed by tourists; Enjoy a Lunch break at one of the best city spots! - Lunch not included Enter the famous Sforzesco Castle, once the residence of Royalty and enjoy a guided tour of the courtyards and the Museum;  See the last incomplete work by Michelangelo, the Pietà, a meditation on death and the salvation of the soul. Experience the vibrant atmosphere, stunning architecture, palaces, museums, mansions, churches, modern shopping galleries, and the beautiful parks at the heart of Milan, Italy’s most fashionable city on this full-day tour of the city highlights. Milan began as a humble 6th-century Celtic village and grew into one of Italy’s most prosperous cities. While it is a large city, the highlights are easily navigable on foot, on this full-day walking tour with your private guide. Experience both modern Milan, with its financial district, and fashionable shopping in the dazzling Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II - home to the major fashion houses like Gucci and Versace, Armani and Ferragamo, as well as its venerable history, from castles to churches and old market squares.Stop outside the Duomo for some holiday snaps – the famous centre point of the city with its Gothic-style spires, and an astonishing cathedral that took over 600 years to complete. Visit the historic Piazza Mercanti – the medieval hub of the city where swords and suits of armour could be bought and sold. It is surrounded by several grand old buildings which your guide will introduce you to Palazzo della Ragione, Palazzo delle Scuole Palatine, Palazzo dei Giureconsulti, Casa dei Panigarola & Loggia degli Osii. End your tour with a private guided tour of the iconic Sforzesco Castle including the courtyards and the Museum. Admire the last incomplete work by Michelangelo, the Pietà and other renowned artists such as Leonardo Da Vinci. Please note that some rooms at Sforzesco Castle might be closed due to restorations.

data.name: Leonardo da Vinci's Last Supper guided tour with local expert guide
data.description: Leonardo da Vinci’s Last Supper is an artistic treasure that skillfully captures a range of human emotion. Such an important painting deserves not just a regular visit but one where you can see and learn about it in full detail and without hassle. This exclusive guided tour, led by an expert local guide, will help you do exactly that — discover all there is to know about da Vinci's celebrated masterpiece.Da Vinci’s prized painting reveals the reactions of the 12 disciples as they learn that one of them would betray Jesus. From surprise to anger to disbelief, their evoked feelings are cleverly conveyed through this masterful depiction of the well-known scene. Valentina, one of our expert local guides, says ‘Each expression, gesture, and posture has a deeper meaning that you can only fully distinguish by gazing upon it with your very own eyes.’Meet your knowledgeable guide in Piazza Santa Maria delle Grazie before entering to behold one of the most admired paintings on the planet, created by one of the greatest geniuses that ever existed. Inside, your guide will help you unravel all the mysteries behind this famous composition. ‘It’s truly a dream come true to spend a day in the presence of a masterpiece like the Last Supper,’ Valentina says. She continues ‘As it’s slowly deteriorating, The Last Supper might not be around forever. So, it’d be a good idea to not wait until it’s too late to visit this exemplary work of art.’

data.name: Teatro Dal Verme: Alessandro Cadario, Dardust, Orchestra I Pomeriggi Musicali
data.description: Experience the timeless brilliance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart at the renowned Teatro Dal Verme. Nestled in the heart of Milan, the Teatro Dal Verme invites classical music aficionados to an extraordinary evening with their 'Teatro Dal Verme: Mozart' event. This musical journey features two of Mozart's most cherished works, offering an unparalleled experience for attendees. First on the program is the 'Concerto per violino n. 5 in La Maggiore, K 219,' beautifully capturing Mozart's profound mastery of the violin concerto. The evening continues with the splendor of the 'Symphony No. 36 in C, K. 425,' also known as the Linz Symphony. Each performance at Teatro Dal Verme: Mozart promises to resonate with fans of classical music, leaving a lasting impression. The Teatro Dal Verme, renowned for its exceptional acoustics, serves as the perfect venue for this celebration of Mozart's genius. Whether you're a seasoned enthusiast or a newcomer to the classical scene, this event at Teatro Dal Verme: Mozart offers a remarkable opportunity to immerse yourself in the enduring beauty and complexity of Mozart's work.

data.name: Teatro Dal Verme: Saint-Saëns, Chausson, Debussy and others
data.description: Immerse yourself in a captivating evening of orchestral wonders at Teatro Dal Verme: Saint-Saëns, Chausson, Debussy and others. Nestled in the heart of Milan, the historic Teatro Dal Verme invites music enthusiasts to an unmissable performance featuring an exquisite program. As the lights dim, experience the elegant 'Sarabande per orchestra d’archi op. 93' by Camille Saint-Saëns, a piece that truly showcases the beauty of string ensembles. Following this, Ernest Chausson's poignant 'Poème op. 25' promises to evoke deep emotional resonances. The evening continues with the enchanting 'Danse sacrée e Danse profane per arpa e archi L103' by Claude Debussy, a delicate interplay between harp and strings. Audiences will then be swept away by Darius Milhaud's 'Cinéma-fantaisie per violino e orchestra op. 58b', a lively and cinematic experience. The crescendo of the night arrives with the electrifying 'Waxman: Carmen Fantasy per violino e orchestra', based on Georges Bizet's famous themes. Teatro Dal Verme: Saint-Saëns, Chausson, Debussy and others is more than a concert it's a journey through musical genius, bringing the legendary works of these renowned composers to life in the iconic setting of Teatro Dal Verme. Don't miss your chance to witness an evening where art and ambiance converge beautifully.

data.name: Teatro Dal Verme: George Pehlivanian
data.description: Immerse yourself in a night of enchanting melodies and exquisite compositions at the majestic Teatro Dal Verme, as the esteemed conductor George Pehlivanian takes the stage. Renowned for his dynamic interpretations and masterful presence, Pehlivanian leads the orchestra through a mesmerizing program that promises to captivate audiences from start to finish. The evening begins with the ethereal 'Piccola musica notturna' by Luigi Dallapiccola, a piece that evokes the serene beauty of a moonlit night. Next, experience the rich, romantic sounds of Edvard Grieg’s 'Peer-Gynt-Suite Nr. 1 op. 46,' where each note paints a vivid picture of Nordic landscapes and folklore. The pinnacle of the evening comes with the enthralling performance of 'Shahrazād op. 35' by Nikolai Andreyevich Rimsky-Korsakov, a symphonic suite inspired by the tales of the Arabian Nights, filled with vivid imagery and ornate orchestral color. Set in the elegant confines of Teatro Dal Verme, this concert guarantees an unforgettable evening of musical brilliance under the skilled direction of George Pehlivanian. Don't miss the opportunity to witness this blend of artistic prowess and architectural splendor at Teatro Dal Verme.

data.description: Visit Florence with a comfortable one-day trip from Milan. Depart in the morning from Milano Centrale train station and in just 2 hours you will reach the heart of Florence, the city of Renaissance! Once arrived in Florence, your skip-the-line Ticket for the Uffizi Gallery will allow you to visit all the art treasures and of the most renowned Renaissance artists in a completely independent way, without stress and wasting time! Included in your ticket entrance, our interactive and easy to use App will guide you inside the Museum. Feel free to spend as much time as you wish! Strolling down the marvelous halls of the gallery, you will be overwhelmed by the unrivaled beauty of the Ognissanti Madonna by Giotto, the Spring and Birth of Venus by Botticelli, the Annunciation and the Adoration of the Magi by Leonardo, the Tondo Doni by Michelangelo, the Bacchus by Caravaggio and many others. The rest of the day is at your leisure: you will have free time to explore the historic center of Florence, walk to the spectacular Piazza della Signoria, the iconic and picturesque Ponte Vecchio, and admire the beauty of the monumental complex of the Duomo, with the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore and the famous Brunelleschi's Dome. data.name: Florence Renaissance and Medieval: Day Trip from Milan
data.description: Visit Florence with a comfortable day trip from Milan. Depart in the morning from Milano Centrale train station and in just 2 hours you will reach the heart of Florence, the city of Renaissance! Led by a local professional guide, your day will start with a comprehensive Walking Tour, discovering the most iconic sights of Renaissance and Medieval Florence. You will first explore the Medici district, where you will admire the famous Medici Palace, built in the mid 15th century and the first residence of the powerful and proud family, the ancient San Lorenzo Church and the Medici Chapels, with their mausoleum. A few steps away, you will be breathless in front of the beauty of the monumental complex of the Duomo, with the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, the iconic Brunelleschi's Dome, the elegant Giotto's Bell Tower and the beautiful Romanesque Baptistery of San Giovanni, with its golden “Porta del Paradiso. The tour then goes through the characteristic streets of the medieval district where Dante and Beatrice lived and where you can also admire the imposing and unique Church of Orsanmichele, a masterpiece of Florentine Gothic art, adorned with the statues of the patron saints of the powerful medieval trading guilds. You will be led then to the picturesque Straw Market: don’t forget to rub the nose of the famous “porcellino” (little pig). Going on, you will find yourself in Piazza Signoria, one of the most beautiful squares in the world and the political center of the city. In this “open-air museum”, be fascinated by the beautiful Fountain of Neptune with the imposing marble statue of Ammannati and by the sculptural masterpieces of the Loggia dei Lanzi, including the Perseus by Cellini and the Rape of the Sabines by Giambologna. Dominating the square, the majestic Palazzo Vecchio with Arnolfo's crenellated tower, one of the most famous symbols of Florence. Following from the outside the spectacular elevated path of the Vasari Corridor, you will arrive at the romantic and picturesque Ponte Vecchio, the oldest bridge in Florence, and you will end this amazing walking tour admiring its renowned jewelry shops! Then, have a break and enjoy a delicious Tuscan Lunch in a typical restaurant located in the old town (if option selected, otherwise free time for lunch). The rest of the day is at your leisure: you can enjoy your free time going for some shopping and discover unique art crafts in the numerous Florentine artisan shops, taste local products in one of the restaurants on the first floor of the Central Market or just sit at the table of a historic café in Piazza della Repubblica.

Enjoy a cycling adventure in Milan’s Old Town, including top attractions as well as quiet nature spots. See the iconic Duomo di Milano, Fashion District, and more. Extended options: see also the Sforza Castle, La Scala, Columns of St. Lawrence, and more.

Choose one of our excellent tour options tailored to your needs and interests:

2H: Old Town Highlights by Bike

Choose this option to explore highlights of Milan's Old Town on a bike. See the Duomo di Milano, Royal Palace, the Fashion District, and more.

4H: Old Town & Sforza Castle by Bike

Choose this option to see more highlights of Milan's Old Town on a bike. See the Sforza Castle, La Scala, Duomo di Milano, Royal Palace, the Fashion District, and more.

6-hour: Old Town, Sforza Castle & Roman Columns by Bike

Choose this option to explore highlights of Milan's Old Town on a bike. See the Basilica di Sant’Ambrogio, Columns of St Lawrance, Sforza Castle, La Scala, Duomo, and more.

data.name: From Milan: Daytrip to Parma with Cheese Factory Tour and Lunch
data.description:
Begin your journey with a visit to an authentic Parmigiano Reggiano DOP dairy farm, where you’ll witness the entire production process—from the cows that provide the milk to the final stages of crafting this iconic cheese. Discover traditional methods and enjoy a tasting of this world-famous delicacy at its source.

Next, dine at a cozy Italian tavern specializing in Culatello di Zibello, a prized delicacy in Italian gastronomy. Relish a lunch featuring local specialties, including cured meats, fresh bread, and fine regional wine. Then, explore a fascinating aging cellar beneath a magnificent 17th-century palace, part of a complex dating back to the 1200s.

The tour continues to Parma, the heart of the Food Valley. Enjoy at least an hour of free time to explore its elegant city center, admire historic architecture, shop for local products, or soak in the lively ambiance.

Return to Milan, concluding a day of extraordinary flavors, history, and culture in Italy’s Food Valley.

data.name: Discover Lecco on a Car Tour from Milan
data.description:
Discover Lake Como and Bellagio on this semi-private full-day tour from Milan. Designed for small groups of up to 8 people, this tour offers a personalized experience with the comfort of private transportation.

Start your journey with a scenic drive to Como and a guided walking tour through the historic center. Explore charming streets, admire elegant architecture, and enjoy the vibrant lakeside atmosphere.

Continue to a hilltop trattoria above Bellagio, where you’ll savor a delicious lunch while soaking in breathtaking views of the peninsula.

After lunch, descend to Bellagio, known as the “Pearl of the Lake”. Enjoy free time to explore cobblestone streets, visit boutique shops, or relax by the lake.

End the day with a guided wine tasting at a local winery, sampling regional wines and learning about winemaking traditions.

This semi-private tour blends guided experiences with leisure, allowing you to fully enjoy the natural beauty and cultural richness of Lake Como and Bellagio.

data.name: Milan: Cooking Class and Tasting at a Cesarina's Home
data.description: Learn the secrets and tricks of the most famous dishes of Milanese cuisine and taste the fruit of your work in the company of a glass of local wine.The Cesarine are the ambassadors of the Italian culinary heritage, the first Italian network of expert certified cooks. The Cesarine preserve the oldest recipes of the Italian gastronomic tradition handed down from generation to generation and welcome travelers into their homes for an authentic experience of sharing.During the lesson, the Cesarina will reveal the tricks of 3 authentic Milanese recipes. Have fun testing your culinary skills. Each participant will have a station equipped with tools and all the ingredients to make the recipes.

data.name: Charming Canals: Professional Photoshoot at I Navigli
data.description: What makes this tour unique is the combination of Naviglio Grande’s rustic beauty with the expertise of a professional photographer who knows the best angles and lighting. Whether it’s a romantic couple’s session, a family shoot, or a solo portrait, the canal’s vibrant charm and serene setting ensure high-quality, one-of-a-kind images that celebrate Milan’s artistic and cultural spirit.

data.name: Lake Como Private Boat Cruise Experience with Train Upgrade
data.description: Swap the city sights of Milan for the lakeside allure of Lake Como with this day trip from Milan. Showcasing the highlights of the glamorous northern lake, the excursion packs in a lot in just one day. Choose from two tour options when booking—one with two private cruises and one with a private morning cruise and a ride on a Bernina red train.

data.name: Duomo di Milano: Rooftop Only Guided Tour
data.description:
Prepare for an exciting 60-minute tour of the rooftop terraces of Milan's iconic Duomo. Meet at the bustling Piazza del Duomo and witness the cathedral's lovely façade adorned with intricate statues, soaring spires, and fanciful gargoyles.

Bypass the ticket office lines and follow the guide straight to the elevator entrance. Enjoy the exhilarating ride to the top, where the magnificent rooftop of this architectural wonder will greet you.

Take in the scenic 360-degree views of Milan from this elevated perspective. On clear days, you can even see the Italian Alps—the natural boundary between Italy and Switzerland—on the horizon.

Climb an additional 50 steps to reach the pinnacle, where the radiant golden statue of the Virgin Mary tops the main spire.

data.name: Milan: A Food Lover's Walking Tour of the Navigli District
data.description: Eat like the locals in this foodie walking tour of the trendy Navigli neighborhood. Stroll its picturesque canals with your guide and indulge your tastebuds with hand-stretched pizza, fresh cuts of carpaccio and gorgonzola, and traditional chickpea pancakes. Get a step-by-step guide to creating a world-class tiramisù, and customize your own version. Leave your tour with an enriched understanding of Milanese culture, history, and cuisine.

data.name: Milan - Private Historic Walking Tour
data.description:
During this walking tour, you will get to see some of the most popular tourist attractions of Milan along with a local- professional guide who will be exclusively with you.

The walking tour would last for about two hours and can be customized accordingly to your taste and preferences.

The tour timings are flexible and can be amended depending upon availability.

In case of any special request, please do let us know and we would try our best to accommodate accordingly.

data.name: Welcome to Milan: Private Half-Day Introductory Walking Tour
data.description: Experience the vibrant atmosphere, stunning architecture, ancient ruins, modern galleries, beautiful parks and the heart of fashionable Milan, the financial and fashion hub of Italy with an expert private guide. On your private walking tour, you will: Embark on an introductory city tour of the highlights of Milan, Italy’s financial hub and fashion centre; Hear how locals describe Milan - the experiences that have shaped their worldview, and how they feel about fashion, tourism, and the future; See the famous Teatro Alla Scala, one of the world's oldest and most famous theatres; Walk along with the iconic Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, with its luxury fashion shops and the famous quadrilatero della moda; Pick up invaluable recommendations, advice, and tips on finding the best, local food as you explore highlights and off-the-beaten-track side streets; Stop for photos in front of the famous Duomo, Milan’s stunning centrepiece; Visit the Chiesa San Satiro, known for its false apse, an architectural optical illusion, attributed to Donato Bramante; Wander through Piazza degli Affari and hear about the meaning of Il Dito sculpture; Learn all about modern life in Milan while taking in the atmosphere and the beauty of this vibrant city; Admire the Chiesa di San Maurizio al Monastero Maggiore with stunning frescos that often go missed by tourists; See the famous Sforzesco Castle, once the residence of the Royalty. A 6th-century Celtic village that grew into one of Italy’s most prosperous cities, the centre of Milan is easily navigable on foot. Famous historical attractions, like the Duomo Cathedral and La Scala Opera House, are easily reached as is the temple of Italian designer brands, the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II.Milan is famous as the financial and fashionista hub of Italy. Looking good or ‘La Bella figura’ is an art form in the city and people-watching the oh-so-stylish Milanese is a lesson in panache. Milan is also Europe’s wealthiest non-capital city. Its cuisine is Italian of course but peppered with exotic influences, from border nations and globe-trotting chefs to migrant kitchens. Full of Michelin restaurants, but also out-of-the-way tavernas, local trattorias, and unpretentious cafes down cobbled side streets, Milan has it all. Enjoying a private, guided tour with a local guide will help you discover the treasures hidden in plain sight throughout the city. As you snap pictures of the Piazza del Duomo and tiny squares accessed through pedestrian archways, hear how Milan became one of the most important financial and fashion centres in Europe. Enjoy an immersive walking tour through Milan’s highlights and its world-renowned shopping streets.

data.name: Milano: esperienza di guida in Ferrari su strada - 40 min. (15km)
data.shortDescription:
Mettiti alla guida di un'auto Ferrari, provando ad accelerare sulla superstrada che collega Milano alle Alpi svizzere. Sfreccia lungo la galleria preferita di Ayrton Senna e ascolta il motore rombante di quest'iconico e famoso "Cavallino Rampante".

Mettiti alla guida dell'auto dei tuoi sogni, provando una Ferrari lungo la leggendaria superstrada che collega Milano alle Alpi svizzere. Ripercorri le orme del celebre pilota Ayrton Senna, viaggiando su una delle strade pù belle al mondo.

Impara come si guida una macchina sportiva, sia a livello teorico che pratico, comprendendo come portarla a velocità elevate. Scopri come accelerare, frenare e mantenere il corretto assetto di guida quando sei al volante e sfrecci lungo la superstrada. Dopo un'introduzione sui componenti della tua postazione di guida, metodi di cambio e pedali per accelerare e frenare, potrai partire e conquistare la strada.

Percorri 15 chilometri con un istruttore copilota per garantire la tua sicurezza. Sentiti a tuo agio grazie a un pilota esperto che ti darà preziosi consigli mentre sei alla guida di un'auto Ferrari per circa 40 minuti.

Cosa è incluso
  • Esperienza di guida individuale su strada di 15 chilometri
  • Copilota esperto
  • Tasse, oneri e costi di gestione
  • Assicurazione
Cosa è escluso
  • Prelievo e rientro in hotel
  • Extra

Servizio di pick-up

Puoi usufruire del prelievo dall'ultima stazione della metro di Milano (linea rossa) su richiesta. Usufruisci del prelievo da altre zone di Milano o limitrofe, pagando un piccolo sovrapprezzo.

Informazioni utili

  • I bambini possono partecipare come passeggeri e verranno condotti dal titolare dell'azienda per ragioni di sicurezza
  • L'attività è soggetta a condizioni climatiche favorevoli
  • In caso di pioggia o strade bagnate, il copilota prenderà il controllo dell'auto e i partecipanti viaggeranno come passeggeri. In questo caso la guida non sarà riprogrammata né rimborsata
  • Se la guida viene cancellata a causa di maltempo, i partecipanti possono scegliere una nuova data o il rimborso
  • I partecipanti sono tenuti a vestirsi in modo adeguato evitando tacchi alti, sandali e infradito
  • Per partecipare bisogna avere l'assicurazione di viaggio
  • Per guidare è necessario essere in possesso di patente di guida
  • Se non si è cittadini europei bisogna presentare il passaporto
  • L'esperienza è adatta a uomini e donne
  • Il tipo di guida verrà stabilito in base ai desideri dei partecipanti e alle loro capacità
  • Per guidare bisogna avere almeno 21 anni, gli altri possono partecipare come passeggeri

data.name: Varenna, Bellagio & Lugano: Guided Tour from Milan + Lake Como Cruise
data.description:
In Varenna, walk through narrow streets filled with colorful houses and visit shops that sell local products. Follow the scenic Lovers' Walk along the shore for views of the lake and mountains

Next, head to Bellagio, situated on a peninsula. Walk through the town's cobblestone streets with beautiful houses and shops leading to squares with lake and mountain views.

Continue to Lugano, a Swiss city located on the shores of Lake Lugano. Spend some free time in the city center, where you can find shops offering Swiss chocolate.

Let us take you to your destination in all discretion and safety aboard a premium vehicle.

data.name: Como and Bellagio Day Trip from Milan with Scenic Lake Cruise
data.description: Join an unforgettable day trip to discover the most iconic destinations on Lake Como, departing by bus from Milan. Explore the city of Como and the village of Bellagio with its historic villas and enchanting atmosphere.After about an hour's journey, you'll arrive in Como, a city rich in history and charm. Take a stroll through its fascinating medieval alleys, explore the elegant squares, and admire the magnificent Gothic cathedral, an architectural masterpiece.You'll then continue to Bellagio, known as the "Pearl of Lake Como." This picturesque village is famous for its charming alleys, breathtaking views, and sophisticated atmosphere, making this town one of the most beloved destinations on Lake Como.Next, a scenic cruise on the lake will offer spectacular views of the shores and historic villas reflected in the crystal-clear waters. At the end of the day, you'll return to Milan by bus after experiencing the magnificence of Lake Como in all its splendor.

data.name: Tickets for museum of senses in Milan
data.description: The Museum of Senses offers an extraordinary experience for both adults and children, designed to awaken all your senses through immersive exhibits and interactive activities.As you step inside, leave all your certainties behind and let yourself be guided on a journey through the areas dedicated to the senses: sight, hearing, smell, touch, taste, and more. With its interactive elements, the museum invites you to rediscover the power of the senses, encouraging you to feel more, explore new perspectives, and learn in surprising ways.This is a place where fun and knowledge intertwine, both astonishing and mysterious at the same time.

data.name: Verona Sirmione Lake Garda Boat Cruise From Milan
data.description:
Join us on a seamless journey from Milan to explore the enchanting cities of Verona and the breathtaking landscapes surrounding Lake Garda. This full day tour combines history, culture, and natural beauty for an unforgettable experience.

Your adventure begins with a smooth departure from Milan, ensuring a relaxed start to your day. In Verona, immerse yourself in the city’s rich heritage by visiting iconic landmarks like Juliet’s House, the grand Arena di Verona, and the charming historic streets adorned with timeless architecture.

Next, you'll arrive in Sirmione, a town brimming with charm and historical significance. Embark on a private boat tour around the scenic peninsula of Lake Garda, guided by a local captain. Enjoy panoramic views of the historic town, the imposing Scaliger Castle, and the beautiful Grottoes of Catullus, ancient Roman ruins that add an intriguing layer to the surroundings.

data.name: Bernina Express with Guaranteed Panoramic Seat from Milan
data.description: The Bernina Express is one of the most dazzling rail lines in the world and with this experience, you’re guaranteed the best seat in the house. Skip the hassle of arranging transportation to the departure and arrival stations with round-trip bus transport directly from Milan and settle into a panoramic seat for spectacular views of the Alpine peaks between St. Moritz and Tirano.

data.name: Easily Make Pasta, Bruschetta & Tiramisù
data.description:
Welcome to my cozy home, where you'll uncover the secrets of authentic Italian home cooking. Join me on a culinary journey to explore the rich traditions, vibrant flavors, and heartfelt essence of true Italian cuisine.

Since 2018, I’ve had the pleasure of being a culinary instructor, sharing my passion and expertise with food enthusiasts from around the globe. In my kitchen, you’ll discover the importance of high-quality ingredients and learn how Italians embrace the "sacred" art of cooking and dining at home, savoring meals in the company of family and friends.

• Discovering my family secrets will help you to prepare easily Italian homemade food

• Tailor the dishes to guests' dietary preferences and exclude any allergens (Except gluten intolerance)

• Vegan and Vegetarian friendly experience

• Get to access to valuable information about Milan and Sicily

data.name: Navigli district guided tour and aperitif
data.description: Discover Milan like a true local with an exciting walking tour through the famous Navigli, the city's most vibrant and historic neighbourhood!Start at Porta Genova and follow the scenic path along the Naviglio Grande, immersing yourself in the authentic heart of the city. Wander through historic alleys, ancient courtyards, and art workshops as your local guide reveals secrets and curiosities about the Navigli, the beating heart of Milan’s nightlife and culture.The tour continues to the Darsena, Milan's ancient dock, now a lively meeting point where history and modernity merge amid trendy spots, markets, and picturesque views. Here, you'll discover the fascinating connection between the city and its waterways, breathing in the atmosphere of the past.To wrap up in true Milanese style, head to the Colonne di San Lorenzo, a historic spot where you can enjoy an authentic apéritif in one of the area's traditional bars, surrounded by the lively Milanese vibe.

data.name: Create your wedding rings: course-experience for future spouses!
data.description:
The experience will guide future spouses in the world of craftsmanship and creativity by creating their own wedding rings in a historic Milan laboratory together with a professional goldsmith.

Together we will choose the model, we will merge the gold, we will shape and weld the rings, we will clean and engrave them.

The experience gives the possibility to the spouses to recycle their own "family gold", maybe old and closed in a drawer, which always has a very strong emotional meaning and to which we will give a new sustainable life.

The experience includes the workshop for creating wedding rings, which will last from 2 to 3 hours depending on the model to be made. Engravings, a photographic reportage of the most beautiful moments and the aperitif at the end are included, while any gold costs (if the spouses did not have it and we had to provide it) are extra.

The experience provides a style of faith on the classic: for more complex models we will have to agree first.

data.name: AC Milan Football Match
data.description:
Experience the excitement of AC Milan matches with exclusive tickets. Join passionate fans and watch Italian football at its best. Cheer alongside fellow supporters in the historic San Siro Stadium.

From the moment you enter San Siro, you'll feel the energy and excitement. Enjoy the passion of the Rossoneri fans as they support their team.

Whether you're a die-hard football fan or just want to enjoy a world-class event, AC Milan matches at San Siro offer ultimate enjoyment for everyone.

data.name: Last Supper self-guided audio tour on your phone without ticket
data.description: Start your tour in the Santa Maria delle Grazie in Milan and experience the grandeur of the Last Supper with a self-guided audio tour on your phone designed by an accredited expert.Listen to fascinating stories, based on an award-winning storytelling concept, and gain great insights into one of the most iconic masterpieces of art. Start your tour from the square and continue on to discover the Last Supper before getting fascinated by Santa Maria delle Grazie.Don't miss the opportunity to explore Santa Maria delle Grazie and the Last Supper at your own pace and to discover the secrets that Milan hides.

data.name: Bernina Red Train Experience from Milan
data.description:
Prepare for a scenic travel from Milan to St. Moritz, located in the Swiss Alps. Witness beautiful landscapes, exciting alpine activities, and the medieval town of Tirano.

Travel aboard the legendary Bernina Red Train, a Swiss engineering gem renowned for its UNESCO World Heritage route. With a knowledgeable guide on hand, this trip promises unforgettable memories.

data.name: Pasta and Gelato 3-hour Cooking Masterclass in Milan
data.description: Are you ready to embark on a culinary adventure? Dive into this pasta and gelato cooking class in Milan, where you'll master the art of creating Italy's most beloved dishes from scratch. A charismatic and knowledgeable chef will guide you through the process, ensuring you learn to craft two types of exquisite handmade pasta and a delightful Italian dessert featuring a special version of gelato. This class is an absolute must for food lovers.Begin your gastronomic journey by learning to create handmade pasta such as tagliatelle or ravioli. Your chef will share traditional techniques passed down through generations, revealing the secrets behind achieving the ideal texture and flavour. You'll then pair your pasta with two seasonal sauces, prepared using fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Whether it's a zesty pesto or a rich tomato sauce, you'll discover how to balance flavours and textures to complement your pasta perfectly.But what's an Italian meal without a sweet ending? In this class, you'll also learn to whip up a superb version of gelato. Your chef will divulge the best ingredients, natural colours, and techniques required to create this creamy delight. Once your feast is ready, sit back and savour your creations, accompanied by two glasses of wine. To top off this unforgettable experience, you'll receive a digital booklet with recipes and a "Graduation Certificate" to impress friends back home. So why wait? Join this experience and deepen your appreciation for Italian cuisine while boosting your culinary confidence.

data.name: Milan Hidden Treasures Bike Tour
data.description: Take a 3-hour guided bike ride through Milan and see the city’s hidden sites in the center and areas that are not on regular tour routes. Ride away from the noisy and busy city center, visit an aristocratic residential area and a modern city quarter, stop at a typical bar for coffee, home-made ice cream or a Milanese cocktail.

data.name: Custom Italian Feast Cooking Class in Milan
data.description:
Join a Milan kitchen and select your own four-course menu guided by regional tradition. Choose your preferred appetizer, pasta or risotto, sauce and dessert, then learn the techniques that bring these dishes to life.

Shape fresh pasta, simmer specialty sauces and finish with a sweet ending like tiramisù or biscotti. Enjoy your creations in a relaxed, small-group setting and toast your efforts with your own wine or limoncello. Leave with recipes and inspiration to cook Milanese favorites at home.

data.name: Milan Italian Lakes and Swiss Alps 6-Day Group Tour
data.description: Spend six days exploring the Italian lakes and Swiss Alps on this small-group tour from Milan. Travel comfortably in a private vehicle with a driver and relax in included accommodation for five nights. Spend time at Lake Como, Lugano, Lausanne, Interlaken, and more and admire the stunning countryside of this part of the world.

data.name: Lake Iseo & Franciacorta: Guided Tour from Milan + Wine Tasting
data.description:
Travel from Milan to Lake Iseo and the Franciacorta wine region. Start your trip in Milan and head to Lake Iseo, surrounded by hills and vineyards.

In Iseo, walk through the historic town and view its architecture and the lake. If you opt for the full package, take a cruise around Monte Isola, Europe's largest lake island, to see lakeside life.

Then, visit the Franciacorta wine region, known for its sparkling wines. At a winery, learn about wine production and have a guided tasting of Franciacorta wines.

A guide will share information about the region's history, culture, and winemaking traditions. See the beauty of Iseo and the quality of Franciacorta wines on this tour.

data.name: Milan: Italian Wine Tasting with Sommelier
data.description: Start an Italian wine-tasting experience with a professional sommelier! Rates Adult (Ages 18+) € 76 Min: 2 people Duration 1 hour Details Relax in a classy wine bistro in central Milan and start an Italian wine-tasting experience with a professional sommelier! Taste several gourmet Italian wines from various regions of Italy. Learn more about the history of Italian wine and grape varieties. The tour includes a tasting of three carefully selected Italian wines accompanied by cheese and charcuterie. You can also purchase any of your favorite wines at the end of the tasting. Make your way to one of the classiest and most famous wine bars in Milan, near the Arco della Pace in Parco Sempione, to begin your private wine tasting. Three of Italian finest and the most popular wines will be carefully selected for you by a professional Italian sommelier, who will tell you more about grape varieties and local wine, fermentation and wine-tasting techniques. But this tasting experience isn't just about wine: your sommelier has paired a selection of regional specialties to each wine – such as cheese, cold cuts, olives, and local bread. Wine pairings make an integral part of fine wine experience and right match-ups complement and enhance the wine’s taste and flavor. You can also purchase any of your favorite wines at the end of the tasting. Learn the art of wine and enjoy a lively introduction to the best wines of Italy. For the perfect recipe, wine will be paired with cheese, cold cuts and delicious, homemade appetizers. Inclusions 3 Italian wines selected by wine expert Appetizers with Cheese and cold cuts tasting English Speaking Sommelier

data.name: Dining experience at a local's home in Monza with cooking demo
data.description: There's no better way to discover Italy's culture from the inside. Our national network of expert Italian home cooks offers the finest Italian food experiences. Immerse yourself in a private dining experience with an Italian family with a 4-course menu (starter, pasta, main course and dessert with drinks included: water, selection of local wines and coffee) showcasing authentic Italian recipes passed down by real Italian Mammas in family cookbooks. Enjoy a cooking demonstration, where your host will show you their cooking skills as they finish the dishes in front of you. Feel the warmth of Italian hospitality by connecting with local people. You'll come away with happy memories, new friends, and a deeper understanding of your destination, as you taste the typical dishes that real Italians cook every day.
